result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: layout is consistent, spacing is even, and no broken or overlapping elements were found. A few minor cosmetic and accessibility observations remain.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' and 'Trattoria Piccola' card images appear blurred/low-resolution, looking like unfinished placeholder assets compared to the crisp poké bowl image next to them.
issues.suggestion: Replace with the actual high-resolution restaurant photo or a proper placeholder image so listings look consistent.

issues.description: The profile/avatar button in the top-right shows only a small red dot with no label or explanation, which may be unclear to users (and is not conveyed to screen readers).
issues.suggestion: Add a visible notification badge with a count or make it distinguishable without relying on color alone (e.g., a bell icon with badge).
